title: Parallel Systems (Redundancy)
hook: One supplier, one platform, one person who knows how it works. That's three ways to go down.
statement: Have real backups for anything critical to your business.
explainer: A backup only counts if it won't fail for the same reason. Two suppliers sharing one warehouse are really one point of failure with two names.
sop: List every single point of failure: one supplier, platform, or key person.
Estimate the Fail Rate of each critical piece and its backup.
Build one true backup for each: second supplier, written process, trained person.
Test it on purpose by faking the failure.
Re-check quarterly. Unused backups go stale.
equation_example: Main supplier fails 10% of the time, backup fails 20%. 1 - (0.10 × 0.20) = 0.98, so 98% reliable. Higher means both would have to fail at once to hurt you. Lower means one bad day still takes you down.
question: Write down one critical thing in your business that has no backup right now.
closing_statement: An untested backup is just a hope.
caption:
Principle Nº 210: Parallel Systems (Redundancy)

One supplier, one platform, one person who knows how it works. That's three ways to go down.

Have real backups for anything critical to your business.

Your turn: Write down one critical thing in your business that has no backup right now.
